passeyyaṁ,.l: Tattha Satthārañca vatāhaṁ passeyyaṁ, Bhagavantameva passeyyan
passeyyaṁ,.g: sace ahaṁ Satthāraṁ passeyyaṁ, imaṁ Bhagavantaṁyeva passeyyaṁ.
sace ahaṁ sammāpaṭipattiyā suṭṭhu gatattā Sugataṁ nāma passeyyaṁ, imaṁ Bhagavantaṁyeva passeyyaṁ.
